cards.name: bo bo bo orb bo bo

skill_descs.wall: Intercepts attack damage dealt to the Commander.
skill_descs.armored: Reduces damage taken from each attack.
skill_descs.counter: After being attacked, deal damage to attacker.
skill_descs.heal: Restore health to a random injured allied Assault.
skill_descs.rally: Increase attack of a random allied Assault.
skill_descs.strike: Deal damage to a random enemy Assault.
skill_descs.weaken: Reduce attack of a random enemy Assault.
skill_descs.siege: Deal damage to a random enemy Structure.
skill_descs.pierce: Bypass damage protection for attack damage.
skill_descs.poison: When attacked, Poison the attacker. Poison deals damage at the end of turn, then halves.
skill_descs.leech: After dealing attack damage to an Assault, permanently gain health.
skill_descs.berserk: After dealing attack damage, permanently increase attack.
skill_descs.enfeeble: Inflict Enfeeble on a random enemy Assault, causing it to take extra damage from each instance of damage.
skill_descs.protect: Give Protect to a random allied Assault, causing it to take less damage from each instance of damage.
skill_descs.enhance: Increase power of skill on a random allied Assault.
skill_descs.jam: Inflict Jam on a random enemy Assault, preventing them from acting next turn. Cools down between activations.
skill_descs.corrosive: When attacked, Corrode the attacker, removing attack after attacking and reducing protection from attacks. Removed after failure to attack.
skill_descs.inhibit: At turn start, inflict Inhibit on opposing Assault, causing it to avoid allied skills.
skill_descs.flurry: After attacking, activate skills and attack again. Cools down between activations.
skill_descs.valor: On first activation, if opposing Assault has more attack, permanently increase attack.
skill_descs.overload: Give Overload to a random ally Assault, causing its skills to become unavoidable and irreducible.
skill_descs.legion: Deal extra attack damage for each other allied Assault of the same Faction.
skill_descs.payback: Enemy Assault skills that target this also target the user of that skill.
skill_descs.avenge: When a friendly Assault dies, permanently increase attack and max health. Half effect for non-adjacents.
skill_descs.refresh: At end of your turn, heals self.
skill_descs.evolve: A random friendly Assault with s changes that skill to s2 until next turn.
skill_descs.venom: Deal extra attack damage to Poisoned enemies. After dealing attack damage, inflict Poison.
skill_descs.besiege: Deal damage to a random enemy Structure or half damage to a random enemy Assault if no Structures.
skill_descs.swipe: After attacking an Assault, deal damage to adjacent enemies.
skill_descs.rupture: Deal extra Attack damage and bypass damage reduction for Attack damage.
skill_descs.rush: Reduce an allied Assault’s delay by 1.
skill_descs.sunder: Reduce attack of random enemy Assault and it can't gain attack or deal extra damage.
skill_descs.enrage: Give Berserk to another random allied Assault.
skill_descs.allegiance: When you play another card of this Faction, permanently gain attack and max health.
skill_descs.drain: After attacking, Swipe and then heal self for the total amount of damage dealt by Swipe plus Attack.
skill_descs.stasis: When this or another Assault of the same faction is played, it gains Protect until it activates.
skill_descs.revenge: Enemy Assault skills that target this also target the user of that skill and adjacent Assaults.
skill_descs.mimic: Use a random enemy Assault's activation skill at Mimic's power. Ignores Faction restrictions and cooldown.
skill_descs.coalition: Deal extra attack damage for each different faction among allied Assaults.
skill_descs.sabotage: At turn start, inflict Sabotage on opposing Assault, reducing the power of its activation skills.
skill_descs.barrier: At turn start and after taking damage, Protect self.
skill_descs.entrap: Give Counter to a random allied Assault.
skill_descs.subdue: Before being attacked, permanently inflict Subdue, negating permanent attack and max HP gains.
skill_descs.tribute: Friendly Assault skills that target this unit also target the user of that skill.
skill_descs.summon: Create a new card at the end of your board.
skill_descs.bravery: At turn start, if the opposing Assault has higher attack, permanently gain attack.
skill_descs.absorb: Absorbs damage dealt by enemy skills each turn.
skill_descs.disease: At turn start, permanently inflict Disease on opposing Assault, negating healing and max health gains received.
skill_descs.mark: After attacking an Assault, permanently inflict Mark, causing it to take extra damage from each attack.
skill_descs.fortify: Give extra maximum health to adjacent Assaults.
skill_descs.hunt: After attacking, deal damage to the leftmost enemy Assault.
skill_descs.scavenge: When another card dies, permanently gain maximum health.
skill_descs.flying: Attacks are dodged 50% of the time, but never when you want it to.

skill_descs_all.evolve: All friendly Assaults with s change that skill to s2 until next turn.

skill_descs_all.enrage: Give Berserk to all other allied Assaults.
skill_descs_all.entrap: Give Counter to all allied Assaults.
